# Keep the Light 1.30.0

- **New Plex-style name format.** Names are now joined by dots and include the new file's resolution, HEVC and its HDR kind, for example "Heat (1995).2160p.HEVC.DV.{tmdb-949}.mkv" or "The Office (2005).S01E02.Diversity Day.1080p.HEVC.mkv". As before, you see every name before anything is renamed.
